smallest_supported_claim: This source-bound native run reached game minutes 8220, 8225 and 8230 without a debug intervention. The 8220 production scan had smoke, sound and light all absent; the 8225 scan observed isolated local-field smoke at source OMT (140,41,0) and the native camp state contained one smoke-signal lead there. At 8230 smoke was observed again, but the camp state contained a new smoke-signal lead at (140,40,0) while the (140,41,0) lead retained last_seen 8225. The run therefore does not establish unchanged-source create-then-dedup.
causal_account: The run and source/executable binding are current and exact. Accepted native waits crossed the relevant cadence boundaries. J0007 records the first cadence's smoke-absent scan; J0020 records the first observed smoke scan and corresponding camp lead; J0027 records the later smoke scan and changed lead set. Because no smoke callback existed at 8220 and a distinct OMT lead appeared at 8230, the required first-create plus unchanged identity/count/hash dedup sequence was not observed. Performance telemetry was collected but remains unassessed because the selected session had no comparable baseline or turn-alarm configuration.

citations.meaning: Exact scenario, source, executable, run and cockpit binding.
At the first five-minute boundary, the isolated production smoke channel was absent while sound and light were also absent.
At minute 8225, the source-bound isolated smoke channel observed local-field smoke at OMT (140,41,0); the native surface retained the staffed-camp smoke lead and no debug intervention.
At minute 8230, smoke remained observable but a distinct (140,40,0) smoke lead appeared while the prior (140,41,0) lead remained at last_seen 8225; this is not unchanged identity/count/hash dedup.

contradictions: J0007: the first cadence boundary had no observed smoke source, so no first-cadence create event was retained.
J0027: the later boundary added a distinct smoke lead at (140,40,0) instead of retaining a single unchanged lead identity/count/hash.
remaining_unknowns: Whether a source whose emitted smoke footprint remains at one stable OMT across both cadence boundaries produces the required dedup receipt.
Whether the staged source's natural smoke spread is the reason for the distinct OMT lead, or exposes a production identity/dedup defect.
A comparable populated-workload baseline and configured turn alarms remain unavailable for performance acceptance.
